entities.summary: Ye Lwin is a Burmese eye surgeon and politician who served as the mayor of Myanmar's second largest city, Mandalay. He was concurrently appointed as the minister of Mandalay Region Municipal and the chairman of the Mandalay City Development Committee on 5 April 2016. Ye Lwin was previously an honorary professor at University of Medicine, Mandalay.
